description: One world: time (dayTime 0–23999), day, moon phase, whether beds work, weather, difficulty, PvP, its own spawn, border, game rules, and load. Without world, every loaded world with its key and player count. include adds `rules` (types and defaults), `size` (chunks generated, km² explored, disk), and `respawn` (the server's spawn point, where players join and respawn without a bed).

world.description: World name or key, such as `world`. Leave out to list them
